title: 二一八七 移形换影入绝地 自废双耳险脱生二一八六 身陷包围无出路 歪打正着落暗河
content_zh:
“对了，这里环境特殊，你小子要是发现什么异常之处，记得及时提醒老子！”又走了一会儿，红龙王忽然开口道。
“晚辈明白。”壮汉连连点头。
“我说你小子，听到了就给个反应。”红龙王催促道。
“晚辈听到了！”壮汉一脸疑惑，稍稍拔高了声音。
“唉…都是被你小子害的，老子居然疏忽了这茬。”红龙王忽然转过身来，一脸无奈，“如果不趁现在把事情和你这榆木脑袋交代清楚，之后还不一定会遇到什么麻烦。”
“事情？什么事情？”壮汉不解。
“你看过就知道了。”红龙王一脸平静，撩开了那半张完整的脸庞。
“大人，晚辈愚昧，实在看不出有什么…咦？”说着，壮汉忽然瞳孔一缩，面色瞬间变得惨白，“大人，您…您的耳朵，难道…”
别看红龙王这半张脸皮肉还算完整，但是他的耳朵却成了一个血窟窿，此种伤势看起来和对侧完全相同，都是被高温灼伤。
“别瞎猜了。”红龙王撇了撇嘴，“老子不像你们凡夫俗子那般爱惜脸面，不稀罕在这种事情上面骗你。这些伤的确是老子为了自保，迫不得已才使用了这种自残手段！”
听红龙王这么说，壮汉不由得打了一个哆嗦，下意识摸向了自己的耳朵。
“放心，老子更不稀罕对你这种?包下手。”红龙王先是嗤笑，然后才长叹一声，将自己身上发生的事情娓娓道来。
因为此事说来话长，红龙王只能将不重要的事情三言两语带过，为了之后的重点做铺垫。
虽然红龙王也可以直接从重点说起，但他实在担心如果自己不将前因后果掰碎揉烂了，对方听得云里雾里还是会耽误正事，倒不如多在这上面花费一些时间。
当年，红龙王因为一些事情留在了这里，想尽了各种方法都没能回到自己的那方世界。
后来有人找上门来，说他可以帮助红龙王开辟一道回家的通路，但前提条件便是要让他去往地府，成为六殿殿主之一。
这人，便是三毒！
为了回家，红龙王只能被迫答应对方的条件。虽然他早就看出这三毒并非善类，也提前做出了防范准备，可惜他还是小瞧了三毒的阴险程度，终于在潜移默化之下受到三毒影响，完全成为了对方棋子。
如果仅是如此红龙王倒也认栽，直到一天他发现自己在这大陆上唯一的亲人死在了三毒手上，内心所有的反抗情绪终于在瞬间爆发。
能轻而易举当上殿主，红龙王的本事可想而知。为了报仇，红龙王拼尽了所有手段，甚至不惜要与对方同归于尽！

遗憾的是，就在红龙王即将得逞之时，三毒却突然来了一招移形换影，将他和自己的化身一起转移到了这个与世隔绝之处。
等到红龙王发现自己中计的时候已经来不及，他才降落城中，便有无穷黑影向他包围而来，要让他死无葬身之地！
瘦死的骆驼比马大，红龙王就算到了精疲力竭的地步，却还是与这群黑影缠斗了三天三夜不落下风。最后还是三毒通过自爆化身偷袭得逞，让红龙王昏迷片刻，才被黑影占了便宜。
丧失意识的时间虽然短暂，可等到红龙王清醒过来的时候却发现自己的躯壳已经被那黑影污染，身上满是斑驳色彩，好似墨染一般！
content_en:
"By the way, the environment here is special. If you find anything unusual, remember to remind me in time!" After walking for a while, the Red Dragon King suddenly said.
"Junior understands." The strong man nodded repeatedly.
"I told you, kid, give me a reaction when you hear it." the Red Dragon King urged.
"Junior heard it!" The strong man looked puzzled and raised his voice slightly.
"Sigh... It's all your fault. I actually neglected this." The Red Dragon King suddenly turned around with a look of helplessness on his face, "If I don't explain the matter clearly to your stupid head now, I won't necessarily encounter any trouble later."
"Something? What's the matter?" The strong man was puzzled.
"You'll know after seeing it." The Red Dragon King looked calm and lifted half of his face.
"Sir, this junior is stupid, I really can't see anything... Huh?" As he said that, the strong man's pupils suddenly shrank, and his face instantly turned pale, "Sir, you... your ears, could it be..."
Even though this half of the Red Dragon King's face is still intact, his ear has become a bloody hole. This injury looks exactly the same as the opposite side, both of which were burned by high temperature.
"Stop guessing." The Red Dragon King curled his lips, "I don't care about face like you ordinary people, and I don't care about lying to you about this kind of thing. These injuries are indeed self-injury that I had to use in order to protect myself!"
Hearing what the Red Dragon King said, the strong man couldn't help but shiver and subconsciously touched his ears.
"Don't worry, I'm not afraid of someone like you." The Red Dragon King first sneered, then sighed and recounted what happened to him.
Because this matter was a long story, the Red Dragon King could only talk about unimportant matters in a few words, paving the way for the next important points.
Although the Red Dragon King could just start with the key points, he was really worried that if he didn't break down the causes and consequences, the other party would still be confused and delay the business. It would be better to spend more time on this.
Back then, the Red Dragon King stayed here because of some things, and tried various methods but failed to return to his own world.
Later, someone came to the door and said that he could help the Red Dragon King open a way home, but the prerequisite was that he should go to the underworld and become one of the six hall masters.
This person is the Three Poisons!
In order to return home, the Red Dragon King was forced to agree to the other party's conditions. Although he had long seen that these three poisons were not benevolent and had made precautionary preparations in advance, unfortunately he still underestimated the insidiousness of the three poisons. Finally, he was subtly affected by the three poisons and completely became the opponent's pawn.
If that was the case, the Red Dragon King would admit defeat, until one day he found out that his only relative on the continent had died at the hands of the Three Poisons, and all the resistance in his heart finally broke out in an instant.
To be able to become the master of the palace easily, one can imagine the capabilities of the Red Dragon King. In order to take revenge, the Red Dragon King tried all means, even willing to die with the other party!
Unfortunately, just when the Red Dragon King was about to succeed, the Three Poisons suddenly used a trick of disembodiment, transferring him and his incarnation to this isolated place.
When the Red Dragon King realized that he had fallen into the trap, it was already too late. He landed in the city and was surrounded by endless black shadows, trying to kill him without a burial place!
A skinny camel was bigger than a horse. Even though the Red Dragon King was exhausted, he still fought with these black shadows for three days and three nights without losing. In the end, the three poisons succeeded in a sneak attack by self-destructing their incarnations, leaving the Red Dragon King unconscious for a moment before the black shadow took advantage of him.
Although the time of losing consciousness was short-lived, when the Red Dragon King woke up, he found that his body had been contaminated by the black shadow, and his body was full of mottled colors, as if stained by ink!
